source.bank: P-banking (2026-11-11). Ids 35853-35862 are the client's ten Coin Shop bank upgrades, from the FreeRealms-Legacy@9e08202 ClientItemDefinitions (AGPL-3.0-or-later): name, description, icon (ImageSets 8131 bank_upgrade_coin), type 30, category 62, stack 1, member discount, the NoTrade/NoSale/ForceDisablePreview flags, and Unknown36 = the donor's Param1, the slots the upgrade adds. Cost (R) is the wiki Banking page's coin price (1,000 to 50,000): the donor's Cost (5 to 50) is not a coin price. Id 910900 is the Storage Vault (R): the client's own model hsg_storage_vault_01.adr (Models.txt 4443, in the community asset manifest), name 2601 'Bank', description 14142 (the 'Visit a Robgoblin Banker today!' tip), icon 93 category_bank, and the Storage Rack's (16850) housing columns (type 1, category 53, rank 1, stack 1); no trade or sale. Id 35852 is the 50-Slot Bank Upgrade the Marketplace sold for 100 Station Cash with no purchase limit (wiki); the same donor columns (icon 8132 bank_upgrade_sc, stack unlimited, Class 168, rarity 3). Cost (R) is 25,000 coins: no Marketplace shelf lists bank upgrades here, so it is a repeatable Coin Shop upgrade at the ten upgrades' own rate of 500 coins a slot.
